answer: Put deductible-style first-offense bond at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Cloning 429 keys multiplies the price 429-fold: 49764 POA locked, or 6006 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One river of signal, one nadir of cost, one wander of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
